$comment: Layer C for LEDGERX vs the real GnuCOBOL harness image (VSAM V1, docs/vsam.md). The record protocol is the stage-2b one unchanged: a seed line IS the record image (AC-ID X(5), AC-BAL 9(5)V99), so record k binds its numeric field to input variable k and the READ inside the PERFORM UNTIL loop forks the record count through the unroller. What INDEXED adds is ordering, which is a property of the record set rather than an arithmetic obligation - so the obligations here are the 1.5% fee's ROUNDED half-cent boundary and the GOLD tier branch over the accumulated total, while FIRST/LAST ordering is carried dynamically by layers A and B on every case.
